name: io.github.nwiizo/tfmcp
title: tfmcp
description: Local-first Terraform MCP server with Registry lookup, Terraform CLI workflows, plan/state analysis, module health checks, and safety gates.

environmentVariables.name: TERRAFORM_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Terraform project directory to inspect and operate on.

environmentVariables.name: TFMCP_ALLOW_DANGEROUS_OPS
environmentVariables.description: Enable Terraform operations that can change infrastructure.

environmentVariables.name: TFMCP_ALLOW_AUTO_APPROVE
environmentVariables.description: Allow auto-approve for gated Terraform operations.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Enable gated HCP Terraform / Terraform Enterprise write operations.

environmentVariables.name: TFE_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise base URL.

environmentVariables.name: TFE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise API token for read-only tools.

environmentVariables.name: TFE_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS verification for trusted private TFE installations.

environmentVariables.name: TFE_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum HCP/TFE response bytes returned to MCP clients before truncation.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport mode: stdio or streamable-http.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host address for streamable HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for streamable HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint path.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HEALTH_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Health endpoint path for streamable HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_METRICS_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Metrics endpoint path for streamable HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SESSION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP session mode: stateful or stateless.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CORS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: CORS mode for streamable HTTP: strict, development, or disabled.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins. Defaults to loopback origins; MCP request Origin validation remains enabled in every CORS mode.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated HTTP Host or authority values accepted by Streamable HTTP. Defaults to rmcp loopback hosts when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP SSE keep-alive interval in seconds. Set to 0 to disable.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ORGANIZATION_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated HCP/TFE organizations allowed for remote MCP requests.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL
environmentVariables.description: Maximum HTTP requests per minute across the server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Maximum HTTP requests per minute per MCP session.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TLS_CERT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: PEM certificate file for HTTPS Streamable HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TLS_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: PEM private key file for HTTPS Streamable HTTP.
